assertions.assert: Each `bot.ability.processing.input` (turn, stimulus, focus, focus_candidates, choices, held, environment, self, acted, recent, max_context_tokens, completion_reserve_tokens, bytes_per_token and reached; its `<param>`s are model, tier, memory and embedding) is one turn, answered by one `bot.ability.processing.output` to the parent: `{turn, handled: true, selected}` or `{turn, handled: false, failed: true, reason}`, turn the given turn.
With no choices it fails the turn without a model call: reason `the reasoning has no choices to select from`.

With choices it makes one generate call offering the dispatch tool, which allows only the offered events (with their targets); the events of its dispatch calls, in order, are returned as the model gave them with `handled: true`, each `{event, data, reason, target}`, `bot.ability.cognition.ignore` selections included; an empty selection is handled with nothing selected.

A generate call that fails fails the turn with reason `the reasoning failed (<code>)`, the generate service's failure code: `status` for an error status, `truncated` for a reply cut short, `malformed` for an answer that is no chat completion. A selection the dispatch tool refuses (`schema-mismatch`, or `not-json`) is repaired first (decision D142): the call is made again with the rejection as the prompt's feedback, at most twice, and the same rejection twice running, or one once the repairs are spent, fails the turn with reason `Selection rejected: <message>` (the rejection's message, else its code).

A prompt over the projection budgets (262144 encoded bytes, 4096 nodes, 4096 collection items, 65536 characters per scalar) fails the turn without a model call, its reason the budget's message (for example `prompt projection collection item budget exceeded`); recalled turns over the bytes the stimulus leaves are trimmed to the newest that fit, and the turn is reasoned.

Each selection is sent, in order, to the session its target names (`#_scxml_` + target) before the turn ends; a selection without its data is refused by the dispatch tool, whose every branch requires it (decision D231, where D113 sent it with `{}`); a send that fails fails the turn with reason `the reasoning could not run (<error>)`.

With a database it recalls prior episodes, standing directives and the bot's active learned behaviors (named in the system channel's self block, decision D154) before the model call and writes nothing (reflection stores the turn's episode, decision D97), and the turn is handled as without one; a memory that fails fails the turn with reason `Reasoning memory recall failed: ...` without a model call.

Its model call streams its reply when the run's `FLOPPY_STREAM` is `true`, and each `generate.progress` the generate service returns while the reply arrives is sent on to the parent unchanged, so the cognition can bound the stage by inactivity (decision D101).

As the intuition tier (the `<param>` tier `intuition`, decision D144) it may select the deliberative handoff, `bot.ability.reasoning.input`, among its choices: the handoff is never sent, the other selections are sent in order, and it ends `{turn, handled: false, reason: "handoff", acted}`, acted what was sent; a selection without the handoff is handled as reasoning's is, and its failures name the tier (`the intuition failed (<code>)`).

It is long-lived (mosfet.py's Cognition holds its Reasoning and Intuition): it answers each input in turn with nothing of the turn before, and a `bot.ability.processing.cancel` ends the turn in hand unanswered, so the next input is the next turn.

A turn sent before it reached the tier (`reached` false; the cognition sends it as its decision layer takes the turn) is recalled and asked of the model at once, but every selection and draft it would send is withheld, in order, and it is not answered, until an input for the same turn with `reached` true and the same frame (focus, focus_candidates, choices, held, environment, self, acted and recent) reaches it: then what was withheld is sent, in order, and the turn is answered as one sent reached, with no second model call. An input for another turn, or for the same turn with another frame, before the turn reached the tier leaves it unanswered, nothing of it sent, and takes the input as a new turn; a `bot.ability.processing.cancel` ends it unanswered.
